inputSpec.name: fastqs
inputSpec.label: fastq files
inputSpec.help: gzipped fastq files to run STAR aligner on

inputSpec.name: sentieon_tar
inputSpec.label: sentieon tar
inputSpec.help: Tarballed Sentieon package. Currently defaults to use Sentieon 202308.03

inputSpec.name: genome_lib
inputSpec.label: CTAT genome library
inputSpec.help: A CTAT genome library, which is a reference file bundle required by Trinity CTAT tools. This contains the genome indices and reference genome that are needed to run Sentieon STAR aligner

inputSpec.name: opt_parameters
inputSpec.label: Optional additional parameters to be used by STAR aligner
inputSpec.help: The optional additional parameters for STAR aligner. Should be space-delimited, and in the format --parameter-name value e.g. "--alignIntronMax 100000 --alignSJstitchMismatchNmax 5 -1 5 5"
inputSpec.default: --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM --outSAMattributes NH HI AS NM MD --outFilterType BySJout --outFilterMultimapNmax 20 --outFilterMismatchNmax 999 --outFilterMismatchNoverReadLmax 0.04 --alignIntronMin 20 --alignIntronMax 1000000 --alignMatesGapMax 1000000 --alignSJoverhangMin 8 --alignSJDBoverhangMin 1 --sjdbScore 1

outputSpec.name: output_bam
outputSpec.label: Output bam file from STAR aligner

outputSpec.name: output_bam_bai
outputSpec.label: Output bam.bai file from STAR aligner

outputSpec.name: output_bam_alignedtranscriptome
outputSpec.label: Output bam file with --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM - to be used as input for RSEM

outputSpec.name: output_bam_bai_alignedtranscriptome
outputSpec.label: Output bam.bai file with --quantMode TranscriptomeSAM - to be used as input for RSEM
